name: khouwledge
description: Houdini knowledge MCP server connection plus two usage skills: khouwledge-query (docs lookup) and khouwledge-judge (image judgement).

key.title: API key
key.description: Contents of ~/.khouwledge/api-key on the server machine.

host.title: Server host
host.description: khouwledge server address. 127.0.0.1 on the server machine itself.

session.title: Session name
session.description: Name of this machine in the server's trajectory log, e.g. jylee-pc.
